title: Assessment of PKC-dependent activation of LRRK1 in vitro
author: Athanasios Karapetsas
materials: The reaction products can be analysed by quantitative immunoblotting analysis (as described in XXXX). Table 1 lists the primary antibodies that we recommend using, which include antibodies to detect Rab7A phosphorylation at Serine-72. ­Antibody Target Company Cat. number Host species Dilution pS72 Rab7A Abcam Inc. steps.title: Clean glass culture tube
steps.instruction: Wash a disposable glass culture tube with 100 % methanol, then allow it to air‑dry.

steps.title: Add lipids for vesicle preparation
steps.instruction: Pipette 0.5 µL diacylglycerol (stock 10 mg · mL⁻¹) and 5 µL phosphatidylserine (stock 10 mg · mL⁻¹) into the cleaned tube; these amounts generate enough vesicles for 25 reactions of 20 µL each.

steps.title: Vacuum‑dry lipids
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a SpeedVac and dry for 00:10:00 until a translucent lipid pellet is visible; ensure complete removal of chloroform/methanol.

steps.title: Resuspend lipid pellet
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of 25 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 50 mM KCl to the dried lipids and vortex gently until the pellet disappears.

steps.title: Prepare primary 2X master mix
steps.instruction: If using immunoprecipitated LRRK1, perform the IP and washes as described elsewhere before this step. Then prepare a 2X master mix containing: HEPES pH 7.5, 50 mM KCl, 100 mM 2‑Mercaptoethanol, 0.2 % (v/v) MgCl₂, 20 mM ATP, 2 mM CaCl₂, 2 mM phosphatidylserine (200 µg · mL⁻¹), diacylglycerol (20 µg · mL⁻¹).

steps.title: Aliquot primary master mix
steps.instruction: Dispense 10 µL of the 2X master mix into each clean Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Add LRRK1 protein
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL of 200 nM LRRK1 wild‑type protein (final concentration 50 nM) to each tube and equilibrate on ice for 00:05:00. For immunoprecipitated LRRK1, add 10 µL of the 2X master mix plus 5 µL of 25 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 50 mM KCl, 0.1 % (v/v) 2‑Mercaptoethanol to the bead‑bound enzyme.

steps.title: Start PKC‑alpha kinase reaction
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL of 400 nM PKC α (final concentration 100 nM) to each tube; adjust the total volume to 20 µL.

steps.title: First incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction for 00:30:00, then transfer the tubes on ice.

steps.title: Prepare secondary master mix (Mix B)
steps.instruction: Prepare Master Mix B containing: HEPES pH 7.5, 25 mM KCl, 50 mM MgCl₂, 10 mM ATP, 1 mM (component not specified in source).

steps.title: Add secondary master mix
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL of Master Mix B to the tubes from the first incubation.

steps.title: Second incubation
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in a thermomixer set to 30 °C, 1 000 rpm and incubate for 00:45:00.

steps.title: Stop reaction (recombinant)
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL of 4× LDS loading buffer supplemented with 5 % (v/v) 2‑Mercaptoethanol to achieve a final 1× concentration.

steps.title: Stop reaction (immunoprecipitated)
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL of 4× LDS loading buffer to reach 2×, incubate at 70 °C for 00:10:00 to elute LRRK1 from the resin, then centrifuge through a 0.22 µm Spinex column to collect the eluate.

steps.title: Final heat before immunoblot
steps.instruction: Incubate samples at 70 °C for 00:05:00. For immunoprecipitated LRRK1, supplement the sample with 2‑Mercaptoethanol to 1 % (v/v) before this step.
